text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you really gonna do this? You don't need to force yourself to like them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No. A princess is kind to all animals! I'll get over my fear of frogs through sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I really loved the story The Frog Prince when I was little. I even went searching for a frog myself! But when it jumped straight onto my face…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I was so surprised at how slimy it felt that I fainted! But that was then, this is now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hurry and show me that familiar of yours! T-t-t-today I'll stand unfazed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whatever you say! Gimme one sec to open the—waaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-this was a m-m-mistake! I can't do thiiis!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Kawakami! Where are you going?! I already took it off you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wheeze! Gasp! Huh? I feel a bit lighter all of a sudden…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Grrr… Okay, I wasn't totally unfazed, but surely I made some progress! …Right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait… where exactly am I? I must've run really far…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Kawakami Princess begins heading back from wherever she ran off to. But all that running seems to have been good for her health!
